svg.title: A single VLA, a two-system VLA and the course stack
svg.desc: Three block diagrams side by side. Panel 1: camera images and a language instruction go into one VLA model, which outputs robot actions. Panel 2: the same inputs go into a slow reasoning model (an ER model or a VLM, blue), whose output goes straight down to a fast policy (a VLA or an action expert, orange), marked tag 4, which outputs robot actions. A dashed arrow marked tag 5 goes from the robot actions back up to the slow model. Panel 3: ARIAC topics and services, lidar and camera go into an LLM agent or PDDL planner (blue), then through a tool call marked tag 6 to the behavior tree (green), then to the skills package and MoveIt 2 (orange), which send ARIAC trajectory and gripper actions. Dashed arrows marked tag 7 go back up from the skills to the tree and from the tree to the agent.
